interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Agentic Vault keeps plain-Markdown Obsidian memory, budgeted SessionStart handoffs, source-attributed recall, fail-closed git gates and verified backups shared across Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity CLI. Release v0.58.0 hardens SessionStart and vault_doctor against non-rendered hidden Markdown/HTML indirect prompt injection (stripping HTML comments, hidden link-reference comments, and hidden HTML tags while preserving code fences, inline code spans, normal URLs, and trailing/standalone single-token anchors without mutating vault files; arXiv:2611.28763), adds stdlib-only Holm-Bonferroni FWER adjustment (holm_bonferroni_adjust; doi:10.2307/4615733) and PPI++ confidence intervals (ppi_pp_mean_ci; doi:10.1126/science.adi6000, arXiv:2311.01453, arXiv:2601.18777) to scripts/eval_stats.py, adds deterministic recovery guidance (Next legal steps / next_legal_steps) to deny-guard.py (engine=0.58.0 alongside ps-parse.ps1) and vault_task_contracts.py (arXiv:2611.24185), and ships the PR #25 and PR #26 removals of the bundled /aside-repl command and Jarvis Telegram integration (14 commands, 15 Antigravity CLI skills, 1 Codex required skill). Retained from v0.57.0: paired bootstrap CIs, 2-fold cross-fitting, cross-split leakage audits, layout-invariance probing, fail-closed table sync, multi-turn recall framing, and opt-in Stage-2 decision-API reranking. No new runtime dependencies; Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime; publication does not upgrade active installations or vaults. The seven certificate-bound checker files remain byte-identical from v0.55.0 through v0.58.0; when upgrading from v0.54.1 or earlier where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again.
